reason: In the patch's onError (change.patch lines 96-97), `message` is the template literal `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`. A template literal always contains at least ": ", so it is never empty and `t("unable_to_add_guests")` can never be used. The server throws the key `you_do_not_have_permission` (patch line 479), but en/common.json has no such key, so the user sees a raw string like 'FORBIDDEN: you_do_not_have_permission'.
